import sys; sys.path.insert(0, ".")
import random
from run import arrivals, summarize

def lat(times, size, deadline=20.0):  # run.latencies with the deadline as a parameter
    out, cur, free = [], 0, 0.0
    while cur < len(times):
        b = [times[cur]]; dl = times[cur] + deadline; cur += 1
        while cur < len(times) and len(b) < size and times[cur] <= dl:
            b.append(times[cur]); cur += 1
        disp = b[-1] if len(b) == size else dl
        fin = max(disp, free) + 2.0 + 0.2 * len(b)
        out += [fin - a for a in b]; free = fin
    return out

# sanity: reproduces run.py at default deadline
